_meta.description: Amazon Associates and FTC requirements checked against this site. 'status' is the site's compliance state as built. Every row links to the official source.

rules.requirement: State 'As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.' clearly and prominently on the site.
rules.site_implementation: Disclosure bar on every page and beside each affiliate link.

rules.requirement: Show prices and availability only if Amazon serves the link, or the data comes from Creators API / PA API.
rules.site_implementation: No Amazon prices are published. Flag F-02.

rules.requirement: Do not display Amazon customer reviews or star ratings unless obtained through Creators API / PA API.
rules.site_implementation: No star ratings or review counts are published. Flag F-02.

rules.requirement: Every Special Link must include the Associates ID (tag) as a URL parameter.
rules.site_implementation: User-supplied short links are used as given. The tag does not appear in the resolved URLs. Flag F-03.

rules.requirement: Do not use a link shortening service in a way that makes it unclear that the link goes to an Amazon Site.
rules.source_ref: Participation Requirements, Section 3(w); Commission Income Statement, Section 2(g)
rules.site_implementation: The links use link.amazon, Amazon's own short domain, and are labelled as Amazon links. Flag F-04.

rules.requirement: Do not include Amazon trademarks in domain names, subdomains or tags.
rules.site_implementation: Site domain is kanlerxz87-cyber.github.io/Zone4, which contains no Amazon mark.

rules.requirement: Do not buy paid search advertisements on keywords that include Amazon trademarks.
rules.source_ref: Commission Income Statement, Section 2(c); Participation Requirements, Section 3(f)
rules.site_implementation: No paid advertising is connected to this site.

rules.requirement: Do not assign sub-tags to individual end users.
rules.site_implementation: No per-user tracking or sub-tags are used.

rules.requirement: Do not offer incentives for using Special Links, and do not place Special Links in customer reviews or Amazon content.
rules.site_implementation: No incentives or rewards are offered; no links are placed on Amazon.

rules.requirement: Do not display price-comparison data without showing both the lowest new and the lowest used price on Amazon.
rules.site_implementation: No prices are displayed, so no comparison is shown.

rules.requirement: Do not collect or use product listings, descriptions or prices beyond the licence, and do not use data mining, robots or similar data gathering and extraction tools. The Associates IP License repeats the same exclusion for Program Content.
rules.source_ref: Amazon Conditions of Use, 'License and Access'
rules.site_implementation: The verification read product pages with an automated retrieval tool and kept identifiers, brand, category and structured specification fields only. No price, rating or listing prose is published. The compliant route for scale is Creators API / PA API. Flag F-11.

rules.requirement: Do not use AI-generated content from the Amazon Services, or Program Content, to develop or improve large language or multimodal models or other machine learning technology. These clauses restrict training and fine-tuning. They do not, on their own, prohibit writing pages with an AI tool, but the API reuse clause in IP License 2(e) is the binding limit on an automated content pipeline.
rules.source_ref: Amazon Conditions of Use, 'License and Access'
rules.site_implementation: The AI content kit is built, in the site's own words, from verified fields only. No model is trained or fine-tuned on Program Content, and no API content is repurposed. Flags F-12, F-17 and F-20 record the exact limits.

rules.requirement: Disclose a material connection clearly, placed with the endorsement, in simple language that is hard to miss.
rules.source_ref: FTC Disclosures 101 for Social Media Influencers, 'How to Disclose'
rules.site_implementation: The Associates disclosure sentence is shown on every page, including next to each affiliate link.

rules.requirement: Commission income is paid on Qualifying Revenue, which excludes shipping, gift-wrap, handling, taxes, service charges, credits, rebates, card fees and bad debt.
rules.site_implementation: Applies to any future earnings model. No earnings are calculated, because the category rate is unverified (F-01).

rules.requirement: A Qualifying Purchase requires a Special Link click, a 24-hour session and an order within 89 days of the click (for cart purchases), and excludes search-engine-displayed and redirecting links.
rules.site_implementation: Links are direct, with no redirect or intermediate page. Search-engine display is not controlled by this site.

rules.requirement: Link-level disclosure must be clear and conspicuous and placed near each affiliate link, not hidden on another page.
rules.source_ref: Associates Central help: 'Why do I have to identify myself as an Associate?'
rules.site_implementation: The disclosure sentence appears directly under each 'Open Amazon link' button, in the same card or row.

rules.requirement: Any agent that accesses Program Content must identify itself in every HTTP and HTTPS request by putting 'Agent/[agent name]' in the user agent string.
rules.site_implementation: No automated retrieval client ships in this repository. Any future agent must send the Agent/ user agent string. Flag F-17.

rules.requirement: An agent must not conceal or obfuscate that it is an agent, must not mimic human speed or navigation patterns, must not complete or circumvent CAPTCHAs, must answer truthfully when asked whether it is human, and must not work around access limits.
rules.site_implementation: No automated retrieval client ships in this repository. Flag F-17.

rules.requirement: Amazon may limit, including by technical measures, whether and how an agent accesses, uses and interacts with Program Content, and may require an agent to refrain from doing so.
rules.source_ref: Associates Program IP License, Section 4(a) and 4(b)
rules.site_implementation: Recorded on the Automation page. Automated research stays manual until this is settled. Flag F-17.

rules.requirement: Creators API and PA API content may not be accessed for aggregating, analysing, extracting or repurposing Product Advertising Content, or in connection with training or fine-tuning a model, without express prior written approval.
rules.site_implementation: No API client and no API content is used. Flag F-20.

rules.requirement: If prices or availability come from an API and are refreshed less than hourly, a date and time stamp must sit next to them, together with the 'Product prices and availability are accurate as of the date/time indicated' disclaimer.
rules.site_implementation: No price or availability is displayed at all, so no timestamp is required yet. Flag F-21.

rules.requirement: If Product Advertising Content consisting of text is displayed, the 'CERTAIN CONTENT THAT APPEARS ... COMES FROM AMAZON ...' disclaimer must be shown in plain view.
rules.site_implementation: No API text content is displayed. Flag F-21.

rules.requirement: When linking to pages with product lists, the site must have additional original content of its own that is relevant to the link.
rules.site_implementation: The three product articles, the comparison page and the buying guide are original copy written for this site. The marketing content lives on the Marketing content page.

rules.requirement: A site must not have price tracking or price alerting functionality unless Amazon agrees otherwise.
rules.site_implementation: No price tracking or price alerting is built, and the price-tracking metric row on the Automation page is marked Not built. Flag F-18.

rules.requirement: Amazon Marks may be used only by display on the site for the purpose of advertising the availability of products on an Amazon Site with a corresponding Special Link, and must not be used in Search Engine keyword use.
rules.source_ref: Trademark Guidelines 1 to 3; Participation Requirements, Section 6(e)
rules.site_implementation: The site title, meta description, page titles, slugs and suggested keywords contain no Amazon Mark. The wording 'Amazon affiliate' is kept in body text only, and is not a keyword. Flag F-19.

rules.requirement: Program Content, Special Links and Amazon Marks must not be used offline, in print, ebook, mailing or oral solicitation, and any email, SMS or direct message that carries a Special Link must be solicited, meaning the recipient opted in.
rules.site_implementation: No outreach, email or print use of Program Content is built or planned. Any future outreach must be opt-in only. Flag F-26.

rules.requirement: Material provided to Amazon in connection with Program Content is assigned to Amazon as a Your Submission.
rules.site_implementation: No content is submitted to Amazon for approval, so no submission is made. Flag F-20.

rules.requirement: Clicks and impressions must not be artificially generated, and Special Links must not be used to cause a page to open other than as a result of a customer clicking the link.
rules.site_implementation: No traffic generation of any kind is built. Recorded as a rule of the optimisation loop on the Automation page. Flag F-22.
